other_exceptions.description: Verbatim human prompt excerpts; original Russian is human-authored, English translations editorial. Conversation logs retain further human prompts.
Claude contributed separate critiques, literature audits, and C2/C5 idea work; C2/C5 did not become complete essays.
Manuscripts and reports retain quotations, bibliographic titles, source excerpts and preserved source artifacts; not every literal word originates with an AI writer.

readme_suggestion: I set the direction and wrote the prompts. Codex built and maintained the repo and did most of the writing; Claude contributed essays and reviews too. The logs keep my original words.
shorter_alternative: Built with Codex, with AI-written essays by Codex and Claude—and my original prompts kept in the logs.
limits: This checks recorded manuscript provenance and explicit exceptions, not an exhaustive forensic attribution of every character of code or every inherited template.
